pools.title: Will Bitcoin close below $72,500 before November 15, 2026?
pools.description: Bitcoin's daily close is the only print that survives the last-hour wick. Spot is $74,264 (-0.68% in 24h); the strike is -2% versus it.
pools.resolution: YES if the BTC/USDT daily candle on Binance closes at or below $72,500 on any day up to and including 2026-11-15 23:59 UTC. A print at the level intraday without a daily close resolves NO.
